## Outcome

Describe the demonstrable outcome and reference an existing issue. Use `Closes #N`
only when the pull request genuinely completes that issue's intended demo change.

## Checks

- [ ] Tests pass and checked-in reports match their declared scenario.
- [ ] No credential or real citizen data is included.
- [ ] The distinction between native GitHub state and simulated delivery history is preserved.
- [ ] Any intentional change to the 50-issue baseline is explained.
